name: lz_decompress
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: LZSS-style decompressor for pol/ tex/ (src after u32 size header, dst)

name: load_common_pol_tex
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: loads pol\common.bin + tex\common.bin, decompresses, registers models/textures

name: load_tex_set
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: loads tex\<name> by index (table @004f3160), decompresses, uploads textures

name: load_comevtbl
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: loads evt\comevtbl.bin into 009e6400 and rebases pointers

name: evt_rebase_pointers
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: for each u32: if (v & 0xfff80000) == 0x0ce80000 then v += 0xf3b30c00

name: load_stage_evtbl
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: loads evt\<stage table> (index table @005b9130, names @004f3b60), rebases

name: load_coli
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: loads coli\<name> (names @004f3ba4) into 009e6400 + 0x6000 (+0x600 if idx != 0)

name: load_font
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: reads word\font.bin (0x138000 bytes)

name: load_word_list
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: reads word\<Z...>.bin (names @004f3bc8), XOR 0x41, into 00839d28 (max 0xd000)

name: save_read
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: reads 4 x 0xb00-byte save blocks from disguised files (table @005ea000)

name: save_write
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: writes the save blocks back and restores file times

name: win_main_loop
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: PeekMessage pump; calls frame_pace when idle

name: frame_pace
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: 60 Hz pacing: 16.6667 ms target, max 4 frame skip, QPC based

name: dinput_init
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: DirectInputCreateEx

name: keyboard_map
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: maps DirectInput key state via MapVirtualKeyEx/GetKeyboardLayout

name: sound_stream_thread
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: DirectSound streaming (BGM) with SetFilePointer/ReadFile

name: read_ini
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: GetPrivateProfileInt/String settings

name: crt_rand
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: MSVC rand(): s = s*0x343fd + 0x269ec3; return (s >> 16) & 0x7fff

name: crt_srand
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: MSVC srand()

name: seed_rng
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: srand(FUN_0047ed90() ? 0 : g_rng_counter)

name: g_rng_counter
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: seed source for seed_rng

name: g_save_file_names
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: 4 x char* (pol/tv2.bin, pol/komono_0.bin, tex/scr_tod_itm_itamidome2.bin, pol/bg_adv19.bin)

name: tex_upload
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: decode PVR texture (layout/format from desc type) into a D3D surface

name: tex_register
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: register texture desc of a set (creates surface once per id; palette bank via 005eb868)

name: tex_register_model
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: walk model texture refs and create their textures (common.bin path)

name: palette_upload
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: copy palette records (16 x ARGB1555 each) into palette RAM banks

name: tex_palette_bank
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: switch(set) via byte table @493984 + jump table @493910 → palette bank - 1

name: g_tex_set_names
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: char*[set] file names under tex\ (index 0 unused)

name: g_tex_set_descs
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: TexDesc*[set]: {i16 w, i16 h, u32 type, u32 offset, u32 id}

name: g_tex_set_counts
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: i16[set]

name: g_pvr_to_d3d_fmt
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: pixel format → D3D format index (5=1555, 2=565, 6=4444, 8=unsupported)

name: g_palette_records
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: 12-byte records {i16, i16 n=16, u32 ptr, i32 count}

name: g_cur_palette_bank
note (kind: fn = function, data = glob: -1 = default bank 0
